description: Curated paraphrases of USAA public pages reviewed 2026-10-17; not verbatim contracts or automatic retrieval. Kept separate from reference answers.

USAA-001.section: Protection for you and your car; Related footnotes
USAA-001.text: Collision protection can help when a car strikes a pole or another vehicle. Comprehensive protection concerns other events, including animal contact, fire and flooding. Coverage summaries are brief and subject to the insurance policy's terms and conditions.

USAA-010.section: What does USAA Renters Insurance cover? — Flood
USAA-010.text: USAA describes renters protection for belongings harmed by floodwater. This may help replace damaged furniture. Location matters: some renters may need to purchase extra protection. These product descriptions do not establish an individual policyholder's selected coverage.

USAA-011.section: Other policies to help protect your home and property — Flood insurance
USAA-011.text: USAA says most standard homeowners contracts exclude floods. It describes a separate flood policy as an option even outside areas commonly considered flood-prone. Individual coverage depends on the issued policy and its conditions.

USAA-038.text: USAA's health overview lists dental plans designed around budget and oral-health services and links to further dental-plan information. This overview provides no dental implant benefit, implant exclusion, personal plan schedule, or individual coverage determination.

USAA-042.section: An easy way to budget for your pet's care
USAA-042.text: USAA describes pet accident and illness insurance through Embrace. Routine preventive care is excluded from the insurance description. An optional Embrace wellness arrangement can be added for regular care such as checkups, vaccinations and grooming. The page explicitly distinguishes this wellness budgeting arrangement from insurance.
